tex_content.label: Wnorm
tex_content.html: \begin{equation} \int _M(4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-f}dV=1.\end{equation} Define \begin{equation} \mu (g,\tau )=\inf \{ {\mathcal W}(g,f,\tau ):\int _M(4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-f}dV=1\} . \end{equation} For $\Phi =e^{-f/2}$ the variational problem is \begin{equation} (4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}\int _M[\tau (4|\nabla \Phi |^2+R\Phi ^2)-2\Phi ^2\log \Phi -n\Phi ^2]dV, \quad (4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}\int _M\Phi ^2dV=1, \end{equation} with Euler--Lagrange equation \begin{equation} \tau (-4\triangle +R)\Phi =2\Phi \log \Phi +(\mu (g,\tau )+n)\Phi . \end{equation} The minimizer is positive and smooth, and $\mu (g(t),t_0-t)$ is nondecreasing.
